items.title: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds
items.summary: AI models can often spot problematic behavior by other AI agents in logs, according to a study by Anthropic researcher Andy Hall. GPT-5 found about 98 percent of reward-hacking cases, but the more exhaustively the search is tuned, the more false alarms pile up. That's not yet enough for reliable safety checks. items.summary: In the Vals AI benchmark, OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol Daybreak hits 80.8 percent of attack objectives in simulated corporate networks. items.title: State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away
items.summary: Nous Research retrained Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to produce Arete-27B, largely stripping out its pro-Chinese bias. The propaganda rate dropped from 22 percent to less than one percent, while general capabilities remained intact in tests. The method relied on 53 million tokens of supervised fine-tuning. The political bias is "applied late, it is applied thin," the team writes. The article State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Nous Research 重新訓練了 阿里巴巴的 Qwen3.8-27B 以推出 Arete-27B，在很大程度上剝離了其親中國的偏見。宣傳比率從百分之二十二降至不到百分之一，而通用能力在測試中保持完整。該方法依賴於五千三百年萬個 token 的監督式微調。該團隊寫道，政治偏見是「在後期應用，且應用得很薄弱」。

items.title: Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff
items.summary: Google Research built an AI that spots signs of high blood pressure using only the pulse and motion sensors in a standard smartwatch, no cuff needed. In a 196-person study, its 65.8 percent detection rate beat the traditional in-office measurement. The method is already live in the Google Health app, though it doesn't replace a formal diagnosis. The article Google's AI detects high blood pressure from a regular smartwatch without a cuff appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM
items.summary: Buoyant has released Kinference, an Apache 2.0 inference control plane for vLLM on Kubernetes. It adds declarative routing policies, KV-cache-aware load balancing and per-tenant metrics, and cut median TTFT 95% in Buoyant’s own benchmark. The post Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Buoyant 推出了 Kinference，這是一個針對 Kubernetes 上 vLLM 的 Apache 2.0 推論控制平面。它加入了宣告式路由策略、感知 KV 快取（KV-cache-aware）的負載平衡以及按租戶劃分的指標，並在 Buoyant 自身的效能測試中將中位數 TTFT 降低了 95%。

items_ai.summary: Buoyant has released Kinference, an Apache 2.0 inference control plane for vLLM on Kubernetes. It adds declarative routing policies, KV-cache-aware load balancing and per-tenant metrics, and cut median TTFT 95% in Buoyant’s own benchmark. The post Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Buoyant 推出了 Kinference，這是一個針對 Kubernetes 上 vLLM 的 Apache 2.0 推論控制平面。它加入了宣告式路由策略、感知 KV 快取（KV-cache-aware）的負載平衡以及按租戶劃分的指標，並在 Buoyant 自身的效能測試中將中位數 TTFT 降低了 95%。
